title: Default to a one-call slice pickup in agent guidance
lead: The short agent instructions mention `next --show`, but their numbered workflow and reusable implementation prompt still teach separate `next` and `show` calls. Align the default example with the one-call read path so agents spend fewer calls and less context on routine pickup.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The canonical instructions are often consumed instead of the longer reference. Inconsistent examples make the efficient path easy to miss and force an avoidable second CLI invocation.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. A focused assertion or review check confirms the short guide and reusable implementation prompt present `slicer next --show --json` as the standard read path.
2. Existing instruction text and JSON output remain identical to each other.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Update the quick start and reusable prompt to use `next --show --json`, explain that the returned item and slice come together, and preserve the existing read-specification-before-starting rule. Keep the detailed reference aligned. Do not change S95's agent packaging scope or status.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: The short guide and reusable prompt consistently show the one-call read path, and `slicer ai instructions` text/JSON behavior remains valid.
